sql: with m as (select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) as series, market_ticker, avg(pnl/nullif(quantity,0))*100 as c_per_ct, min(created_at) as first from paper_trades where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not ilike '%\_pt%' and side='no' and assumed_price between 93 and 95 and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') and created_at >= '2026-08-11' group by 1,2) select series, count(*) as mkts, round(avg(c_per_ct)::numeric,2) as c_per_ct, sum(case when c_per_ct<0 then 1 else 0 end) as losses, min(first)::date as first, max(market_ticker) as sample from m where series ~ '(MENTION|SAY|APPROV|POTUS|GOLD|SILVER|COPPER|NATGAS|BRENT|WTI|AAAGAS|RAIN|SNOW|HIGH|LOW|TEMP|CPI|PAYROLL|JOBLESS|FED|GDP|INX|NASDAQ|DOW|TREAS|USD|EUR|JPY|ALBUM|SPOTIFY|BILLBOARD|RT|NETFLIX|BOX|TRUTH|TWEET|ELON|WH|MORTGAGE|EGG|TSA|HURR|QUAKE|COVID|TOP)' group by series order by mkts desc limit 150
